# CLC Verses

> Memory Verses flashcard companion for Christ Led Communities' (CLC) 2-Year All-In Curriculum. Displays memory verses from each curriculum module so members can review and memorize them, with support for two Bible translations (NIV and ESV).

This is a static, client-side web app (HTML/CSS/vanilla JavaScript, no build step or backend). Verse and translation text lives in `data.js` as a plain JS object; `app.js` handles rendering, module navigation, translation switching, and view transitions.

Verses are organized into 12 color-coded modules matching the All-In curriculum, with a Module View and an All Verses view, a NIV/ESV translation toggle, and expandable accordion verse cards.
